scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: concurrently "npm run build --prefix backend" "npm run build --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix frontend" "npm run start --prefix backend"
